name: agentel-network-chat-template
description: A Cloudflare Agents chat starter for read-only network discovery through Agentel MCP.

AGENTEL_READER_KEY.description: Obtain your own read-only INFO Reader from https://agentel.tech/connect. Business reads can consume service allowance.

DEMO_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Set a random operator password of at least 24 characters. One operator per deployment.

MODEL_API_KEY.description: Supply your own key for the model endpoint and protocol configured in the Worker. Provider charges are separate.

scripts.e2e:dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.e2e.jsonc --local --env e2e --env-file test/e2e.vars
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:worker: npm run build && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.missing.config.ts
